+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import hashlib
+import hmac
+
+from app.config import get_setting
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_verify_webhook(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    secret = get_setting("WEBHOOK_SECRET")
+    if not secret:
+        return 503, {"error": "not configured"}
+    body = params.get("body")
+    signature = params.get("signature")
+    if not isinstance(body, str) or not isinstance(signature, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    expected = hmac.new(
+        secret.encode("utf-8"), body.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256
+    ).hexdigest()
+    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected, signature.lower()):
+        return 401, {"error": "bad signature"}
+    return 200, {"verified": True}

cd /repo && python - <<'EOF'
import os, hmac, hashlib
from app.api.handlers import handle_verify_webhook as h

# not configured
os.environ.pop("WEBHOOK_SECRET", None)
assert h({"body":"x","signature":"y"}) == (503, {"error":"not configured"}), h({"body":"x","signature":"y"})
os.environ["WEBHOOK_SECRET"] = ""
assert h({"body":"x","signature":"y"}) == (503, {"error":"not configured"})

os.environ["WEBHOOK_SECRET"] = "s3cret"
# invalid requests
assert h({}) == (400, {"error":"invalid request"})
assert h({"body":"x"}) == (400, {"error":"invalid request"})
assert h({"signature":"x"}) == (400, {"error":"invalid request"})
assert h({"body":123,"signature":"x"}) == (400, {"error":"invalid request"})
assert h({"body":"x","signature":123}) == (400, {"error":"invalid request"})

# correct
body = "hello world"
sig = hmac.new(b"s3cret", body.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
assert h({"body":body,"signature":sig}) == (200, {"verified":True})
assert h({"body":body,"signature":sig.upper()}) == (200, {"verified":True})

# wrong
assert h({"body":body,"signature":"00"*32}) == (401, {"error":"bad signature"})
assert h({"body":body+"!","signature":sig}) == (401, {"error":"bad signature"})
print("all good")
EOF
